```gd
class_name CameraRig
extends Node3D
## Orbit-lite RTS camera: WASD pan, Q/E rotate (45° snap), wheel zoom bands.

var zoom_level: float = 0.5   # 0..1
var _target_yaw: float = 0.0

@onready var cam: Camera3D = Camera3D.new()

const PAN_SPEED: float = 14.0
const ZOOM_MIN: float = 10.0
const ZOOM_MAX: float = 34.0


func _ready() -> void:
	add_child(cam)
	_apply_zoom()
	cam.current = true


func _apply_zoom() -> void:
	var dist: float = lerpf(ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX, zoom_level)
	cam.position = Vector3(0, dist, dist * 0.72)
	cam.look_at(global_position, Vector3.UP)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var pan := Vector2.ZERO
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W):
		pan.y -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S):
		pan.y += 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A):
		pan.x -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D):
		pan.x += 1.0
	if pan != Vector2.ZERO:
		var fwd: Vector3 = -global_transform.basis.z
		fwd.y = 0.0
		fwd = fwd.normalized()
		var right: Vector3 = global_transform.basis.x
		right.y = 0.0
		right = right.normalized()
		global_position += (right * pan.x + fwd * -pan.y) * PAN_SPEED * delta * lerpf(0.6, 1.6, zoom_level)
	rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, _target_yaw, minf(1.0, delta * 10.0))


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		match event.button_index:
			MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
				zoom_level = clampf(zoom_level - 0.08, 0.0, 1.0)
				_apply_zoom()
			MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
				zoom_level = clampf(zoom_level + 0.08, 0.0, 1.0)
				_apply_zoom()
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed:
		if event.keycode == KEY_Q:
			_target_yaw += PI / 4.0
		elif event.keycode == KEY_E:
			_target_yaw -= PI / 4.0


## Mouse ray → ground-plane (y=0) point, or null Vector3(INF) when parallel.
func mouse_ground_point(mouse_pos: Vector2) -> Vector3:
	var from: Vector3 = cam.project_ray_origin(mouse_pos)
	var dir: Vector3 = cam.project_ray_normal(mouse_pos)
	if absf(dir.y) < 0.0001:
		return Vector3(INF, INF, INF)
	var t: float = -from.y / dir.y
	if t < 0.0:
		return Vector3(INF, INF, INF)
	return from + dir * t

```

```gd
extends Node3D
## Main scene controller: owns a RunSim, binds BoardView + Hud + CameraRig,
## routes input, drives the sim from SimClock, and hosts the --shot/--demo-bot
## harness for offscreen verification (windows always spawn offscreen in tests;
## owner policy).

var run: RunSim
var board: BoardView
var hud: Hud
var rig: CameraRig
var audio: AudioDirector

enum Cursor { NONE, TOWER, WALL, GATE }
var _cursor: int = Cursor.GATE
var _cursor_tower: TowerDef = null

# Harness
var _shot_path: String = ""
var _demo_bot: bool = false
var _bot_built: int = 0
var _shot_frames: int = 0


func _ready() -> void:
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--shot="):
			_shot_path = arg.substr(7)
		elif arg == "--demo-bot":
			_demo_bot = true

	_setup_environment()
	_new_run()
	SimClock.sim_tick.connect(_on_sim_tick)
	SimClock.paused = false


func _new_run() -> void:
	RunRNG.seed_run(int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()) if not _demo_bot else 20260710)
	run = RunSim.new()
	run.setup(BastionLeague.m1_scenario(), BastionLeague.enemies())

	if board != null:
		board.queue_free()
	board = BoardView.new()
	add_child(board)
	board.bind(run)
	board.show_gate_slots(true)

	if hud != null:
		hud.queue_free()
	hud = Hud.new()
	add_child(hud)
	hud.bind(run, BastionLeague.towers())
	hud.tower_selected.connect(func(d: TowerDef) -> void:
		_cursor = Cursor.TOWER
		_cursor_tower = d
		audio.play(&"ui_click"))
	hud.wall_selected.connect(func() -> void:
		_cursor = Cursor.WALL
		audio.play(&"ui_click"))
	hud.selection_cleared.connect(func() -> void: _cursor = Cursor.NONE)
	hud.confirm_gates_pressed.connect(_on_confirm_gates)
	hud.send_wave_pressed.connect(_on_send_wave)
	hud.restart_pressed.connect(_new_run)
	hud.upgrade_pressed.connect(_on_upgrade)
	hud.sell_pressed.connect(_on_sell)
	if _demo_bot:
		hud.toggle_guide()  # guide starts open for players; bots don't read
	run.phase_changed.connect(_on_phase_changed)

	if rig == null:
		rig = CameraRig.new()
		add_child(rig)
	rig.position = Vector3(float(run.scenario.width) * 0.5, 0, float(run.scenario.height) * 0.55)

	if audio == null:
		audio = AudioDirector.new()
		add_child(audio)
	audio.bind(run)

	_cursor = Cursor.GATE
	_bot_built = 0


func _setup_environment() -> void:
	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-52, -35, 0)
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	sun.light_energy = 0.95
	add_child(sun)
	var env := WorldEnvironment.new()
	var e := Environment.new()
	e.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	e.background_color = Color(0.12, 0.16, 0.2)
	e.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
	e.ambient_light_color = Color(0.55, 0.6, 0.68)
	e.ambient_light_energy = 0.7
	e.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
	# Bloom so additive impact VFX (tracers, blasts, pulses) actually glow.
	e.glow_enabled = true
	e.glow_intensity = 0.6
	e.glow_bloom = 0.1
	e.glow_hdr_threshold = 0.85
	env.environment = e
	add_child(env)


func _on_sim_tick(dt: float) -> void:
	run.tick(dt)
	if _demo_bot:
		_bot_step()


func _on_phase_changed(phase: int) -> void:
	match phase:
		RunSim.Phase.BUILD:
			board.show_gate_slots(false)
			board.mark_tiles_dirty()
		RunSim.Phase.ENDED:
			hud.show_end(run.victory, run.wave_index)
	if phase != RunSim.Phase.SETUP:
		if _cursor == Cursor.GATE:
			_cursor = Cursor.NONE


func _on_confirm_gates() -> void:
	var r: String = run.confirm_gates()
	if r != "":
		hud.toast(r)


func _on_send_wave() -> void:
	var r: String = run.send_wave()
	if r != "":
		hud.toast(r)


func _on_upgrade(i: int) -> void:
	var r: String = run.upgrade_tower(i)
	if r != "":
		hud.toast(r)
	else:
		board.bump_tower_visual(i)
		audio.play(&"upgrade")


func _on_sell(i: int) -> void:
	var r: String = run.sell_tower(i)
	if r != "":
		hud.toast(r)
	else:
		hud.select_tower(-1)
		board.rebuild_tower_visuals()
		board.mark_tiles_dirty()
		audio.play(&"sell")


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_SPACE:
		if run.phase == RunSim.Phase.BUILD:
			_on_send_wave()
		return
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_H:
		hud.toggle_guide()
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		_click(event.position)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
		_cursor = Cursor.NONE if run.phase != RunSim.Phase.SETUP else Cursor.GATE
		hud.clear_selection()
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		_hover(event.position)


func _cell_at(screen_pos: Vector2) -> Vector2i:
	var p: Vector3 = rig.mouse_ground_point(screen_pos)
	if p.x == INF:
		return Vector2i(-1, -1)
	var c := Vector2i(int(floor(p.x)), int(floor(p.z)))
	if not run.grid.in_bounds(c.x, c.y):
		return Vector2i(-1, -1)
	return c


func _hover(screen_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var c: Vector2i = _cell_at(screen_pos)
	if c.x < 0 or _cursor == Cursor.NONE:
		board.set_hover(Vector2i(-1, -1), true, 0.0)
		return
	var rough_ok: bool = true
	var rng: float = 0.0
	if _cursor == Cursor.GATE:
		rough_ok = run.scenario.gate_slots.has(c)
	elif run.grid.in_bounds(c.x, c.y):
		rough_ok = run.grid.is_walkable(run.grid.idx(c.x, c.y))
		if _cursor == Cursor.TOWER and _cursor_tower != null:
			rng = _cursor_tower.range
	board.set_hover(c, rough_ok, rng)


func _click(screen_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var c: Vector2i = _cell_at(screen_pos)
	if c.x < 0:
		return
	match _cursor:
		Cursor.GATE:
			var r: String = run.place_gate(c)
			if r == "":
				board.add_gate_visual(c)
				board.show_gate_slots(true)
			else:
				hud.toast(r)
		Cursor.WALL:
			var r: String = run.place_wall(c)
			if r == "":
				board.mark_tiles_dirty()
			else:
				hud.toast(r)
		Cursor.TOWER:
			if _cursor_tower == null:
				return
			var r: String = run.place_tower(_cursor_tower, c)
			if r == "":
				board.add_tower_visual(_cursor_tower, c)
				board.mark_tiles_dirty()
				audio.play(&"place")
			else:
				hud.toast(r)
		_:
			# No build cursor: clicking a placed tower opens its upgrade panel.
			var ti: int = run.towers.tower_at(run.grid.idx(c.x, c.y))
			hud.select_tower(ti)
			board.show_range_ring(ti)


## --- demo bot + screenshot harness ------------------------------------------

const _BOT_PLAN: Array = [
	["bastion_caltrops", Vector2i(6, 11)], ["bastion_cannon", Vector2i(6, 13)],
	["bastion_ballista", Vector2i(5, 11)], ["bastion_ballista", Vector2i(5, 13)],
	["bastion_longbow", Vector2i(4, 11)], ["bastion_longbow", Vector2i(4, 13)],
	["bastion_cannon", Vector2i(7, 11)], ["bastion_caltrops", Vector2i(7, 13)],
	["bastion_ballista", Vector2i(8, 11)], ["bastion_ballista", Vector2i(8, 13)],
	["bastion_longbow", Vector2i(3, 10)], ["bastion_longbow", Vector2i(3, 14)],
]


func _bot_step() -> void:
	match run.phase:
		RunSim.Phase.SETUP:
			if run.gates.is_empty():
				run.place_gate(Vector2i(23, 12))
				board.add_gate_visual(Vector2i(23, 12))
			run.confirm_gates()
		RunSim.Phase.BUILD:
			while _bot_built < _BOT_PLAN.size():
				var def: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(_BOT_PLAN[_bot_built][0])
				if run.gold < def.cost:
					break
				if run.place_tower(def, _BOT_PLAN[_bot_built][1]) == "":
					board.add_tower_visual(def, _BOT_PLAN[_bot_built][1])
					board.mark_tiles_dirty()
				_bot_built += 1
			run.send_wave()
		_:
			pass


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _shot_path == "":
		return
	_shot_frames += 1
	# Capture mid-combat of wave 2 while the killzone is visibly firing.
	if _shot_frames > 40 and run.phase == RunSim.Phase.COMBAT and run.wave_index >= 1 \
			and run.enemies.count >= 3 and run.kills_total >= 2 \
			and board._impacts.active_count() >= 3:
		var img: Image = get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
		img.save_png(_shot_path)
		print("[shot] saved %s (wave %d, enemies %d)" % [_shot_path, run.wave_index + 1, run.enemies.count])
		_shot_path = ""
		if _demo_bot:
			get_tree().quit(0)
```

```gd
## Palette entry: real tower render on top, name + cost below (owner feedback
## 2026-07-10: every buy button must be text+image so the product is obvious).
func _palette_button(title: String, cost_line: String, icon_key: StringName) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.toggle_mode = true
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(150, 118)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
	b.add_child(v)
	var icon := _icon_rect(Vector2(0, 58))
	icon.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	v.add_child(icon)
	_btn_icons[icon_key] = icon
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = "%s\n%s" % [title, cost_line]
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	v.add_child(l)
	return b


func _icon_rect(min_size: Vector2) -> TextureRect:
	var tr := TextureRect.new()
	tr.custom_minimum_size = min_size
	tr.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	tr.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	tr.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return tr


## Fire-and-forget coroutine: photographs the real tower meshes offscreen and
## drops them onto the palette. No-op headless; cached across run restarts.
func _load_icons(tower_defs: Array[TowerDef]) -> void:
	var icons: Dictionary = await TowerIconRenderer.icons_for(self, tower_defs)
	if icons.is_empty():
		return
	_icons = icons
	for key in _btn_icons:
		var tex: Texture2D = _icons.get(key)
		if tex != null and is_instance_valid(_btn_icons[key]):
			_btn_icons[key].texture = tex


func _stat_label(parent: Node, text: String, color: Color) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	parent.add_child(l)
	return l


func _fmt_def(def: TowerDef) -> String:
	var role: String = ROLE_KO.get(def.id, "")
	var s := "[b]%s[/b]  —  %d🪙\n[color=#9dc]%s[/color]\n" % [def.display_name, def.cost, role]
	if def.damage > 0.0:
		var dps: float = def.damage / def.fire_interval
		s += "피해 %.0f · 연사 %.1f/s · [b]DPS %.1f[/b]\n사거리 %.1f" % [def.damage, 1.0 / def.fire_interval, dps, def.range]
		if def.aoe_radius > 0.0:
			s += " · 범위피해 r%.1f" % def.aoe_radius
		if def.slow_factor < 1.0:
			s += " · 감속 %d%% (%.1fs)" % [int((1.0 - def.slow_factor) * 100.0), def.slow_duration]
	else:
		s += "공격 없음 — 경로 차단 전용"
	if def.tags.has("physical"):
		s += "\n[color=#8fc]시너지: 감속된 적에게 피해 +%d%%[/color]" % int((TowerSim.SLOW_VULN_MULT - 1.0) * 100.0)
	if def.slow_factor < 1.0:
		s += "\n[color=#8fc]시너지: 감속시킨 적은 물리 타워 피해 +%d%%[/color]" % int((TowerSim.SLOW_VULN_MULT - 1.0) * 100.0)
	if not def.tags.is_empty():
		s += "\n태그: [color=#db8]%s[/color]" % " · ".join(def.tags)
	return s


func _show_info_card(def: TowerDef) -> void:
	_info_icon.texture = _icons.get(def.id)
	_info_text.text = _fmt_def(def)
	_info_card.visible = true


func _show_wall_card() -> void:
	_info_icon.texture = _icons.get(TowerIconRenderer.ICON_KEY_WALL)
	_info_text.text = "[b]벽 Wall[/b]  —  1⛰\n[color=#9dc]지형 점수로 짓는 미로 블록. 경로를 길게 구부려 타워 앞 체류시간을 버세요.[/color]\n지형 점수는 웨이브마다 충전됩니다."
	_info_card.visible = true


func _hide_info_card() -> void:
	_info_card.visible = false


## Called by game_root when a placed tower is clicked. -1 clears.
func select_tower(i: int) -> void:
	_selected_tower = i
	if i < 0 or run == null or i >= run.towers.count:
		_sel_panel.visible = false
		return
	_refresh_sel_panel()
	_sel_panel.visible = true


func _refresh_sel_panel() -> void:
	var i: int = _selected_tower
	if i < 0 or i >= run.towers.count:
		_sel_panel.visible = false
		return
	var def: TowerDef = run.towers.def_of(i)
	var lv: int = run.towers.level[i]
	_sel_icon.texture = _icons.get(def.id)
	var s := "[b]%s[/b]  [color=#fd5]Lv%d[/color]\n[color=#9dc]%s[/color]\n" % [def.display_name, lv, ROLE_KO.get(def.id, "")]
	if def.damage > 0.0:
		s += "피해 %.0f · 사거리 %.1f · DPS %.1f" % [run.towers.damage_of(i), run.towers.range_of(i), run.towers.damage_of(i) / def.fire_interval]
	else:
		s += "차단벽"
	_sel_text.text = s
	if run.towers.can_upgrade(i):
		_upg_btn.disabled = false
		_upg_btn.text = "⬆ 업그레이드  %d🪙" % run.towers.upgrade_cost(i)
	else:
		_upg_btn.disabled = true
		_upg_btn.text = "최대 레벨" if def.damage > 0.0 else "업그레이드 불가"
	@warning_ignore("integer_division")
	_sell_btn.text = "판매 +%d🪙" % (def.cost / 2)
	_sell_btn.disabled = run.phase != RunSim.Phase.BUILD


func toggle_guide() -> void:
	_guide.visible = not _guide.visible


func _on_palette(btn: Button, def: TowerDef) -> void:
	if _selected_btn != null and _selected_btn != btn:
		_selected_btn.button_pressed = false
	if btn.button_pressed:
		_selected_btn = btn
		select_tower(-1)
		if def == null:
			wall_selected.emit()
		else:
			tower_selected.emit(def)
	else:
		_selected_btn = null
		selection_cleared.emit()


func clear_selection() -> void:
	if _selected_btn != null:
		_selected_btn.button_pressed = false
		_selected_btn = null


func _on_speed() -> void:
	if SimClock.time_scale >= 2.0:
		SimClock.time_scale = 1.0
	elif SimClock.time_scale >= 1.5:
		SimClock.time_scale = 2.0
	else:
		SimClock.time_scale = 1.5
	_speed_btn.text = "▶ %sx" % ("1" if SimClock.time_scale == 1.0 else ("1.5" if SimClock.time_scale == 1.5 else "2"))


func toast(reason: String) -> void:
	_toast.text = REASON_TEXT.get(reason, reason)
	_toast_ttl = 2.4


func show_end(victory: bool, wave: int) -> void:
	_end_panel.visible = true
	_end_label.text = "🏆 승리 — 협곡을 지켰습니다!" if victory else "💔 코어 함락 (웨이브 %d)" % (wave + 1)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if run == null:
		return
	_gold.text = "🪙 %d" % run.gold
	_tp.text = "⛰ %d" % run.terrain_points
	_core.text = "💙 %d" % run.core_hp
	_wave.text = "Wave %d/%d" % [mini(run.wave_index + 1, run.scenario.waves.size()), run.scenario.waves.size()]
	match run.phase:
		RunSim.Phase.SETUP:
			_phase_hint.text = "🚪 게이트 배치 — 노란 슬롯 클릭 (%d~%d개), 완료되면 [게이트 확정]" % [run.scenario.min_gates, run.scenario.max_gates]
			_confirm_btn.visible = true
			_send_btn.visible = false
		RunSim.Phase.BUILD:
			_phase_hint.text = "🔨 건설 단계 — 미로와 타워를 준비하고 웨이브를 시작하세요"
			_confirm_btn.visible = false
			_send_btn.visible = true
			_send_btn.disabled = false
		RunSim.Phase.COMBAT:
			_phase_hint.text = "⚔ 전투 중 — 건설/업그레이드는 계속 가능합니다"
			_confirm_btn.visible = false
			_send_btn.visible = true
			_send_btn.disabled = true
		_:
			_confirm_btn.visible = false
			_send_btn.visible = false
	_preview.text = _wave_preview_text()
	if _sel_panel.visible:
		_refresh_sel_panel()
	if _toast_ttl > 0.0:
		_toast_ttl -= delta
		_toast.visible = true
		_toast.modulate.a = clampf(_toast_ttl, 0.0, 1.0)
	else:
		_toast.visible = false


func _wave_preview_text() -> String:
	if run.phase != RunSim.Phase.BUILD and run.phase != RunSim.Phase.SETUP:
		return ""
	var wave: WaveDef = run.current_wave()
	if wave == null:
		return ""
	var parts: Array[String] = []
	for e in wave.entries:
		parts.append("%d× %s (게이트 %d)" % [e.count, e.enemy_id, mini(e.gate_index, maxi(run.gates.size() - 1, 0)) + 1])
	return "다음 웨이브:  " + "  ·  ".join(parts)
```

`scripts/game/impact_vfx.gd`:

```gd
class_name ImpactVfx
extends Node3D
## Pooled one-shot impact effects (pure presentation — reads sim events, never
## mutates sim). Kinds:
##   spark — impact star + shrinking glow (single-target hits, death pops)
##   blast — explosion flash card + glow sphere to the AoE radius, chains smoke
##   pulse — flat ring + soft glow expanding to the AoE radius (slow fields)
##   smoke — lingering rising puff (auto-chained after blast)
## Each slot layers a procedural mesh + a CC0 Kenney particle-pack billboard
## (assets/vfx/, see its LICENSES.txt) — owner 2026-07-10: 화려한 이펙트는
## 무료 소스 활용. Per-tower styling via style_for(def) so future faction
## towers get a sane look from their own stats/colors.

const POOL_SIZE: int = 32
const TEX_DIR := "res://assets/vfx/"

var _slots: Array[MeshInstance3D] = []
var _mats: Array[StandardMaterial3D] = []
var _cards: Array[MeshInstance3D] = []
var _card_mats: Array[StandardMaterial3D] = []
var _kind: Array[StringName] = []
var _ttl: PackedFloat32Array = PackedFloat32Array()
var _dur: PackedFloat32Array = PackedFloat32Array()
var _radius: PackedFloat32Array = PackedFloat32Array()
var _color: PackedColorArray = PackedColorArray()
var _base_y: PackedFloat32Array = PackedFloat32Array()
var _next: int = 0

var _mesh_sphere: SphereMesh
var _mesh_ring: TorusMesh
var _tex: Dictionary = {}  # &"flash"/&"smoke"/&"star"/&"glow" -> Texture2D

const _CARD_TEX := {&"spark": &"star", &"blast": &"flash", &"pulse": &"glow", &"smoke": &"smoke"}


func _ready() -> void:
	for key in [&"flash", &"smoke", &"star", &"glow"]:
		var p: String = TEX_DIR + "vfx_%s.png" % key
		if ResourceLoader.exists(p):
			_tex[key] = load(p)
	_mesh_sphere = SphereMesh.new()
	_mesh_sphere.radius = 0.5
	_mesh_sphere.height = 1.0
	_mesh_sphere.radial_segments = 12
	_mesh_sphere.rings = 6
	_mesh_ring = TorusMesh.new()
	_mesh_ring.inner_radius = 0.42
	_mesh_ring.outer_radius = 0.5
	_mesh_ring.rings = 24
	_mesh_ring.ring_segments = 6
	var quad := QuadMesh.new()
	quad.size = Vector2.ONE
	for i in POOL_SIZE:
		var m := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
		mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
		mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
		mat.no_depth_test = false
		m.material_override = mat
		m.visible = false
		add_child(m)
		_slots.append(m)
		_mats.append(mat)
		var card := MeshInstance3D.new()
		card.mesh = quad
		var cmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		cmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
		cmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
		cmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
		cmat.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
		card.material_override = cmat
		card.visible = false
		add_child(card)
		_cards.append(card)
		_card_mats.append(cmat)
		_kind.append(&"")
		_ttl.append(0.0)
		_dur.append(1.0)
		_radius.append(1.0)
		_color.append(Color.WHITE)
		_base_y.append(0.0)


## Tracer + impact styling per tower def. Known M1 towers get bespoke looks;
## anything else derives from stats (slow→pulse, aoe→blast, else spark).
static func style_for(def: TowerDef) -> Dictionary:
	match def.id:
		&"bastion_ballista":
			return {"tracer": Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.5), "tracer_ttl": 0.12,
				"kind": &"spark", "color": Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.6), "radius": 0.35, "dur": 0.16}
		&"bastion_cannon":
			return {"tracer": Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.3), "tracer_ttl": 0.1,
				"kind": &"blast", "color": Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.2), "radius": def.aoe_radius, "dur": 0.3}
		&"bastion_longbow":
			return {"tracer": Color(0.8, 1.0, 0.6), "tracer_ttl": 0.2,
				"kind": &"spark", "color": Color(0.85, 1.0, 0.7), "radius": 0.3, "dur": 0.16}
		&"bastion_caltrops":
			return {"tracer": Color(0, 0, 0, 0), "tracer_ttl": 0.0,
				"kind": &"pulse", "color": Color(0.55, 0.8, 1.0), "radius": def.aoe_radius, "dur": 0.35}
	if def.slow_factor < 1.0:
		return {"tracer": Color(0, 0, 0, 0), "tracer_ttl": 0.0,
			"kind": &"pulse", "color": def.color.lightened(0.35), "radius": maxf(def.aoe_radius, 1.0), "dur": 0.35}
	if def.aoe_radius > 0.0:
		return {"tracer": def.color.lightened(0.4), "tracer_ttl": 0.1,
			"kind": &"blast", "color": def.color.lightened(0.3), "radius": def.aoe_radius, "dur": 0.3}
	return {"tracer": def.color.lightened(0.45), "tracer_ttl": 0.12,
		"kind": &"spark", "color": def.color.lightened(0.4), "radius": 0.35, "dur": 0.16}


func spawn(kind: StringName, pos: Vector3, color: Color, radius: float, dur: float) -> void:
	var i: int = _next
	_next = (_next + 1) % POOL_SIZE
	var m: MeshInstance3D = _slots[i]
	m.mesh = _mesh_ring if kind == &"pulse" else _mesh_sphere
	m.position = pos
	m.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	_kind[i] = kind
	_ttl[i] = dur
	_dur[i] = dur
	_radius[i] = maxf(radius, 0.05)
	_color[i] = color
	_base_y[i] = pos.y
	m.visible = kind != &"smoke"  # smoke is card-only
	var card: MeshInstance3D = _cards[i]
	var tex: Texture2D = _tex.get(_CARD_TEX.get(kind, &"glow"))
	if tex != null:
		_card_mats[i].albedo_texture = tex
		# smoke reads as matter, not light — alpha-mix it; everything else adds
		_card_mats[i].blend_mode = (BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_MIX if kind == &"smoke"
			else BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD)
		card.position = pos
		card.visible = true
	else:
		card.visible = false
	_animate(i, 0.0)
	# A blast leaves a lingering smoke puff behind (separate slot, no re-chain).
	if kind == &"blast":
		spawn(&"smoke", pos + Vector3(0, 0.15, 0), Color(0.72, 0.7, 0.68), radius, dur * 1.8)


func active_count() -> int:
	var n: int = 0
	for i in POOL_SIZE:
		if _slots[i].visible or _cards[i].visible:
			n += 1
	return n


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	for i in POOL_SIZE:
		if not (_slots[i].visible or _cards[i].visible):
			continue
		_ttl[i] -= delta
		if _ttl[i] <= 0.0:
			_slots[i].visible = false
			_cards[i].visible = false
			continue
		_animate(i, 1.0 - _ttl[i] / _dur[i])


## t: 0 = birth, 1 = gone.
func _animate(i: int, t: float) -> void:
	var m: MeshInstance3D = _slots[i]
	var card: MeshInstance3D = _cards[i]
	var c: Color = _color[i]
	c.a = 1.0 - t
	_mats[i].albedo_color = c
	var r: float = _radius[i]
	match _kind[i]:
		&"blast":
			var s: float = lerpf(0.15, r * 2.0, minf(t * 1.6, 1.0))
			m.scale = Vector3(s, s, s)
			var cs: float = lerpf(0.4, r * 2.8, minf(t * 1.8, 1.0))
			card.scale = Vector3(cs, cs, cs)
			_card_mats[i].albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, 1.0 - t * t)
		&"pulse":
			var s2: float = lerpf(0.3, r * 2.0, t)
			m.scale = Vector3(s2, 0.25, s2)
			var cs2: float = lerpf(0.5, r * 1.8, t)
			card.scale = Vector3(cs2, cs2, cs2)
			_card_mats[i].albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, (1.0 - t) * 0.8)
		&"smoke":
			var cs3: float = lerpf(r * 0.8, r * 1.9, t)
			card.scale = Vector3(cs3, cs3, cs3)
			card.position.y = _base_y[i] + t * 0.5
			_card_mats[i].albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, (1.0 - t) * 0.6)
		_:  # spark — star flashes out while the glow shrinks
			var s3: float = lerpf(r, 0.05, t)
			m.scale = Vector3(s3, s3, s3)
			var cs4: float = lerpf(r * 1.7, r * 0.4, t)
			card.scale = Vector3(cs4, cs4, cs4)
			_card_mats[i].albedo_color = c

```

`scripts/game/tower_icon_renderer.gd`:

```gd
class_name TowerIconRenderer
extends SubViewport
## Offscreen icon camera: photographs the real low-poly tower meshes
## (TowerVisualFactory) so HUD buttons show exactly what gets built.
## Headless-safe (test suite): returns {} without touching the render server.
## Icons are cached per def id for the process lifetime, so run restarts reuse them.

const ICON_KEY_WALL := &"wall"
const ICON_SIZE := 128

static var _cache: Dictionary = {}  # StringName -> Texture2D


## Returns {def.id: Texture2D, ..., ICON_KEY_WALL: Texture2D}. Coroutine — await it.
## `host` only parents the temporary viewport; if it's freed mid-render we bail
## with {} and the next bind retries.
static func icons_for(host: Node, defs: Array[TowerDef]) -> Dictionary:
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return {}
	var missing: Array[TowerDef] = []
	for def in defs:
		if not _cache.has(def.id):
			missing.append(def)
	if missing.is_empty() and _cache.has(ICON_KEY_WALL):
		return _cache.duplicate()

	var vp := TowerIconRenderer.new()
	vp.size = Vector2i(ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE)
	vp.transparent_bg = true
	vp.own_world_3d = true
	vp.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_4X
	vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
	var cam := Camera3D.new()
	cam.projection = Camera3D.PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL
	vp.add_child(cam)
	var key := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	key.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48, -30, 0)
	key.light_energy = 1.15
	vp.add_child(key)
	var fill := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	fill.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-20, 150, 0)
	fill.light_energy = 0.45
	vp.add_child(fill)
	host.add_child(vp)

	for def in missing:
		var tex: Texture2D = await _snap(vp, cam, TowerVisualFactory.build(def),
			TowerVisualFactory.visual_top(def))
		if tex == null:
			return {}
		_cache[def.id] = tex
	if not _cache.has(ICON_KEY_WALL):
		var wtex: Texture2D = await _snap(vp, cam, TowerVisualFactory.build_wall_block(),
			TowerVisualFactory.wall_top())
		if wtex == null:
			return {}
		_cache[ICON_KEY_WALL] = wtex

	vp.queue_free()
	return _cache.duplicate()


## Render one subject and return its ImageTexture (null if the viewport died).
static func _snap(vp: SubViewport, cam: Camera3D, subject: Node3D, top: float) -> Texture2D:
	vp.add_child(subject)
	var focus := Vector3(0.0, top * 0.52, 0.0)
	cam.size = top * 1.15 + 0.9
	cam.look_at_from_position(focus + Vector3(2.6, 2.1, 2.6), focus)
	vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	if not is_instance_valid(vp):
		return null
	var img: Image = vp.get_texture().get_image()
	vp.remove_child(subject)
	subject.free()
	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)

```

`scripts/game/tower_visual_factory.gd`:

```gd
class_name TowerVisualFactory
extends RefCounted
## Single source of truth for tower/wall body construction. BoardView (in-world)
## and TowerIconRenderer (palette/info-card icons) both build from here, so a
## button always shows exactly what gets placed — including future faction towers.

const WALL_COLOR := Color(0.34, 0.31, 0.29)  # BLOCKED terrain (tiles + wall icon)


## Low-poly tower node at local origin; caller positions it on the board.
static func build(def: TowerDef) -> Node3D:
	var t := Node3D.new()
	var base := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bbox := BoxMesh.new()
	bbox.size = Vector3(0.8, 0.35, 0.8)
	var bmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	bmat.albedo_color = def.color.darkened(0.35)
	bbox.material = bmat
	base.mesh = bbox
	base.position.y = 0.42
	t.add_child(base)

	var body := MeshInstance3D.new()
	if def.damage > 0.0:
		var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
		cyl.top_radius = 0.16
		cyl.bottom_radius = 0.28
		cyl.height = def.visual_height
		var mat2 := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat2.albedo_color = def.color
		cyl.material = mat2
		body.mesh = cyl
		body.position.y = 0.6 + def.visual_height * 0.5
	else:
		var wbox := BoxMesh.new()
		wbox.size = Vector3(0.9, def.visual_height, 0.9)
		var mat3 := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat3.albedo_color = def.color
		wbox.material = mat3
		body.mesh = wbox
		body.position.y = 0.35 + def.visual_height * 0.5
	t.add_child(body)
	return t


## Top of the built node in local space — used to frame icon renders.
static func visual_top(def: TowerDef) -> float:
	if def.damage > 0.0:
		return 0.6 + def.visual_height
	return 0.35 + def.visual_height


## Player terrain wall as it reads on the board: a BLOCKED tile rises 0.6 above
## ground (h=1.1 bottom-aligned at -0.5 in BoardView._refresh_tiles).
static func build_wall_block() -> Node3D:
	var t := Node3D.new()
	var m := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var box := BoxMesh.new()
	box.size = Vector3(0.96, 0.6, 0.96)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = WALL_COLOR.lightened(0.08)
	mat.roughness = 1.0
	box.material = mat
	m.mesh = box
	m.position.y = 0.3
	t.add_child(m)
	return t


static func wall_top() -> float:
	return 0.6

```

`scripts/game/tower_visual_factory.gd.uid`:


`tests/integration/test_perf_gates.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## M0 hard perf gates — the late-game-performance pillar, enforced from day 1.
##   G-A  flow-field recompute on the shipping map size:  < 100 ms
##   G-B  2,000-enemy sim tick average:                    <   8 ms
## Comparable games die here (Tower Dominion wave-100 freeze, Poly TD endless
## 1-5 fps). These gates never get weakened; content must fit the budget.

const MAP_W: int = 64
const MAP_H: int = 64
const ENEMY_TARGET: int = 2000
const FLOW_BUDGET_MS: float = 100.0
const TICK_BUDGET_MS: float = 8.0


func _scatter_walls(g: SimGrid, blocked_ratio: float) -> void:
	# Deterministic pseudo-maze so the gate measures a realistic field, not open ground.
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = 20260710
	var n: int = int(float(MAP_W * MAP_H) * blocked_ratio)
	for _i in n:
		var x: int = rng.randi_range(1, MAP_W - 2)
		var y: int = rng.randi_range(1, MAP_H - 2)
		if Vector2i(x, y) == Vector2i(1, 1):
			continue
		g.set_terrain(x, y, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)


func test_flow_field_recompute_budget() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(MAP_W, MAP_H)
	_scatter_walls(g, 0.18)
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(1, 1))
	var f := FlowField.new()
	# Warm once (allocation), then measure 5 recomputes and take the average.
	f.compute(g, goals)
	var total_ms: float = 0.0
	for _i in 5:
		total_ms += f.compute(g, goals)
	var avg_ms: float = total_ms / 5.0
	gut.p("flow-field %dx%d avg recompute: %.2f ms (budget %.0f)" % [MAP_W, MAP_H, avg_ms, FLOW_BUDGET_MS])
	assert_lt(avg_ms, FLOW_BUDGET_MS)


func test_enemy_sim_tick_budget_2000() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(MAP_W, MAP_H)
	_scatter_walls(g, 0.12)
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(1, 1))
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, goals)

	var e := EnemySim.new()
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = 42
	var placed: int = 0
	while placed < ENEMY_TARGET:
		var x: int = rng.randi_range(2, MAP_W - 2)
		var z: int = rng.randi_range(2, MAP_H - 2)
		if not g.is_walkable(g.idx(x, z)) or not f.reachable(g.idx(x, z)):
			continue
		e.spawn(float(x) + 0.5, float(z) + 0.5, 100.0, 1.5, placed % 8)
		placed += 1

	# Measure 90 ticks (3 sim-seconds) of pure sim stepping.
	var ticks: int = 90
	var t0: int = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	for _t in ticks:
		e.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, g, f)
	var avg_ms: float = float(Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0 / float(ticks)
	gut.p("enemy sim %d agents avg tick: %.3f ms (budget %.0f), remaining %d" % [ENEMY_TARGET, avg_ms, TICK_BUDGET_MS, e.count])
	assert_lt(avg_ms, TICK_BUDGET_MS)
	assert_gt(e.count, 0, "sanity: field still populated during measurement")


func test_targeting_query_budget() -> void:
	# 300 towers' worth of radius queries against 2,000 enemies must stay cheap.
	var g := SimGrid.new(MAP_W, MAP_H)
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = 7
	for _i in ENEMY_TARGET:
		e.spawn(rng.randf_range(1.0, MAP_W - 1.0), rng.randf_range(1.0, MAP_H - 1.0), 50.0, 1.0, 0)
	var t0: int = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	var found: int = 0
	for _q in 300:
		var hits: PackedInt32Array = e.query_radius(g, rng.randf_range(4.0, MAP_W - 4.0), rng.randf_range(4.0, MAP_H - 4.0), 3.5)
		found += hits.size()
	var ms: float = float(Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
	gut.p("300 radius queries over %d enemies: %.2f ms total (found %d)" % [ENEMY_TARGET, ms, found])
	assert_lt(ms, TICK_BUDGET_MS, "all towers' targeting fits inside one tick budget")

```

`tests/integration/test_run_bot.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## Full-loop bot runs over the real M1 scenario — the M1 vertical-slice gate.
## Proves: gates → build → SEND WAVE → combat → economy → win/lose, headless,
## deterministic, with anti-juggling rules live.


func _fresh_run() -> RunSim:
	RunRNG.seed_run(20260710)
	var run := RunSim.new()
	run.setup(BastionLeague.m1_scenario(), BastionLeague.enemies())
	return run


func _tick_until(run: RunSim, max_ticks: int, done: Callable) -> int:
	var t: int = 0
	while t < max_ticks and not done.call():
		run.tick(SimClock.SIM_DT)
		t += 1
	return t


## The reference bot layout: 1 gate east, a caltrop+cannon kill box near the
## core approach, ballista/longbow backbone. Rebuilt every wave with income.
func _play_full_run(gate_count: int) -> RunSim:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	var slots: Array[Vector2i] = run.scenario.gate_slots
	for gi in gate_count:
		assert_eq(run.place_gate(slots[gi * 2]), "", "gate %d placed" % gi)
	assert_eq(run.confirm_gates(), "")

	var ballista := BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_ballista")
	var cannon := BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_cannon")
	var caltrops := BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_caltrops")
	var longbow := BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_longbow")

	# Kill box in front of the core (core at 3,12): rows of towers flanking x 5..8
	var build_plan: Array = [
		[caltrops, Vector2i(6, 11)], [cannon, Vector2i(6, 13)],
		[ballista, Vector2i(5, 11)], [ballista, Vector2i(5, 13)],
		[longbow, Vector2i(4, 11)], [longbow, Vector2i(4, 13)],
		[cannon, Vector2i(7, 11)], [caltrops, Vector2i(7, 13)],
		[ballista, Vector2i(8, 11)], [ballista, Vector2i(8, 13)],
		[longbow, Vector2i(3, 10)], [longbow, Vector2i(3, 14)],
		[cannon, Vector2i(9, 11)], [cannon, Vector2i(9, 13)],
		[ballista, Vector2i(10, 11)], [ballista, Vector2i(10, 13)],
		[longbow, Vector2i(2, 11)], [longbow, Vector2i(2, 13)],
		[caltrops, Vector2i(11, 12)], [cannon, Vector2i(12, 12)],
	]
	var built: int = 0

	while run.phase != RunSim.Phase.ENDED:
		# Spend available gold down the build plan
		while built < build_plan.size() and run.phase == RunSim.Phase.BUILD:
			var def: TowerDef = build_plan[built][0]
			if run.gold < def.cost:
				break
			var r: String = run.place_tower(def, build_plan[built][1])
			assert_eq(r, "", "bot build %d (%s) accepted" % [built, def.id])
			built += 1
		assert_eq(run.send_wave(), "")
		var w: int = run.wave_index
		_tick_until(run, 30 * 240, func() -> bool:
			return run.phase != RunSim.Phase.COMBAT or run.wave_index != w)
	return run


func test_full_run_victory_one_gate() -> void:
	var run := _play_full_run(1)
	assert_true(run.victory, "bot wins the 10-wave scenario (leaked %d, core %d)" % [run.leaked_total, run.core_hp])
	assert_eq(run.wave_index, 10)
	assert_gt(run.kills_total, 100)


func test_naked_run_loses() -> void:
	# No towers at all → core must fall. Difficulty floor: losing IS possible
	# (Poly TD "you can't lose" complaint is a design bug we test against).
	var run := _fresh_run()
	assert_eq(run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[0]), "")
	assert_eq(run.confirm_gates(), "")
	while run.phase != RunSim.Phase.ENDED:
		assert_eq(run.send_wave(), "")
		var w: int = run.wave_index
		_tick_until(run, 30 * 240, func() -> bool:
			return run.phase != RunSim.Phase.COMBAT or run.wave_index != w)
	assert_false(run.victory, "defenseless run ends in defeat")
	assert_eq(run.core_hp, 0)


func test_extra_gates_pay_more() -> void:
	var run1 := _play_full_run(1)
	var run2 := _play_full_run(2)
	assert_true(run1.victory and run2.victory, "both bots win")
	# Same kills, but the 2-gate run banked more gold via the risk multiplier.
	assert_gt(run2.gold, run1.gold, "risk multiplier pays (1g %d vs 2g %d)" % [run1.gold, run2.gold])


func test_gate_rules() -> void:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	assert_eq(run.place_gate(Vector2i(12, 12)), RunSim.REASON_GATE_SLOT, "not a rim slot")
	assert_eq(run.confirm_gates(), RunSim.REASON_NEED_GATES, "need at least one gate")
	assert_eq(run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[0]), "")
	assert_eq(run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[1]), "")
	assert_eq(run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[2]), "")
	assert_eq(run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[3]), RunSim.REASON_GATE_LIMIT)
	assert_eq(run.confirm_gates(), "")
	assert_eq(run.phase, RunSim.Phase.BUILD)


func test_economy_rules() -> void:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[0])
	run.confirm_gates()
	var ballista := BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_ballista")
	var gold0: int = run.gold
	assert_eq(run.place_tower(ballista, Vector2i(6, 12)), "")
	assert_eq(run.gold, gold0 - ballista.cost, "tower cost deducted")
	# Burn gold to zero, then a build must be rejected without side effects
	while run.gold >= ballista.cost:
		var free := _find_free_cell(run)
		assert_eq(run.place_tower(ballista, free), "")
	var towers_before: int = run.towers.count
	assert_eq(run.place_tower(ballista, _find_free_cell(run)), RunSim.REASON_NO_GOLD)
	assert_eq(run.towers.count, towers_before, "rejected build placed nothing")
	# Selling in BUILD refunds half
	var g_before: int = run.gold
	assert_eq(run.sell_tower(run.towers.count - 1), "")
	@warning_ignore("integer_division")
	assert_eq(run.gold, g_before + ballista.cost / 2)


func test_wall_costs_terrain_points() -> void:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[0])
	run.confirm_gates()
	var tp0: int = run.terrain_points
	assert_eq(run.place_wall(Vector2i(15, 12)), "")
	assert_eq(run.terrain_points, tp0 - 1)
	while run.terrain_points > 0:
		assert_eq(run.place_wall(_find_free_cell(run)), "")
	assert_eq(run.place_wall(_find_free_cell(run)), RunSim.REASON_NO_TP)


func test_anti_juggle_full_block_rejected() -> void:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	run.place_gate(Vector2i(23, 12))
	run.confirm_gates()
	run.terrain_points = 999
	# Wall the full column x=18 — the last wall that would seal the gate must be rejected.
	var rejected: bool = false
	for y in run.scenario.height:
		var r: String = run.place_wall(Vector2i(18, y))
		if r == PathValidator.REASON_BLOCKS_GATE:
			rejected = true
			break
	assert_true(rejected, "sealing the gate off from the core is impossible")


func _find_free_cell(run: RunSim) -> Vector2i:
	for y in range(2, run.scenario.height - 2):
		for x in range(14, run.scenario.width - 2):
			var c := Vector2i(x, y)
			if run.grid.is_walkable(run.grid.idx(x, y)) \
					and not run.scenario.gate_slots.has(c) and c != run.scenario.core_cell:
				return c
	return Vector2i(-1, -1)
```

```gd
extends GutTest
## AudioDirector contracts: all shipped sfx load, every wired EventBus signal is
## survivable headless (Dummy audio driver → play() is a no-op), and the sim
## actually EMITS the combat events audio feeds on (tower_fired/enemy_killed).


func _fresh_run() -> RunSim:
	RunRNG.seed_run(11)
	var run := RunSim.new()
	run.setup(BastionLeague.m1_scenario(), BastionLeague.enemies())
	return run


func test_all_sfx_assets_load_and_events_are_survivable() -> void:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	var ad: AudioDirector = add_child_autofree(AudioDirector.new())
	ad.bind(run)
	assert_eq(ad._sfx.size(), AudioDirector.SFX_FILES.size(), "every sfx file loads")
	assert_not_null(ad._music_build, "build music bed loads")
	assert_not_null(ad._music_combat, "combat music bed loads")
	for def in BastionLeague.towers():
		if def.damage > 0.0:
			assert_true(AudioDirector.SHOT_BY_TOWER.has(def.id),
				"%s has a shot sound mapping" % def.id)
	# Fire every wired event once; reaching the end without errors is the contract.
	EventBus.wave_started.emit(0)
	EventBus.enemy_killed.emit(1, Vector2i(2, 2))
	EventBus.core_damaged.emit(1, 19)
	EventBus.terrain_placed.emit(Vector2i(1, 1), SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	EventBus.gate_placed.emit(0, Vector2i(23, 12), 1, 1)
	EventBus.placement_rejected.emit(Vector2i(0, 0), "cell_taken")
	EventBus.tower_fired.emit(0, 0)  # no towers built yet: guarded, must not crash
	EventBus.wave_ended.emit(0, 45, 2)
	EventBus.run_ended.emit(true, 9)
	pass_test("all wired events survivable headless")


func test_combat_emits_tower_fired_and_enemy_killed() -> void:
	var run := _fresh_run()
	watch_signals(EventBus)
	run.place_gate(Vector2i(23, 12))
	run.confirm_gates()
	var bal: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_ballista")
	assert_eq(run.place_tower(bal, Vector2i(12, 11)), "")
	assert_eq(run.place_tower(bal, Vector2i(12, 13)), "")
	run.send_wave()
	for i in 3600:  # ≤120s sim @30Hz — wave 1 (6 grunts) dies well before this
		run.tick(1.0 / 30.0)
		if run.phase != RunSim.Phase.COMBAT:
			break
	assert_signal_emitted(EventBus, "tower_fired")
	assert_signal_emitted(EventBus, "enemy_killed")
```

`tests/unit/test_flow_field.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## FlowField correctness: distances, blocking, corner-cutting, unreachability.


func _grid(w: int, h: int) -> SimGrid:
	return SimGrid.new(w, h)


func _goals(g: SimGrid, x: int, y: int) -> PackedInt32Array:
	var out := PackedInt32Array()
	out.append(g.idx(x, y))
	return out


func test_goal_cell_cost_zero() -> void:
	var g := _grid(8, 8)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 4, 4))
	assert_eq(f.integration[g.idx(4, 4)], 0)


func test_orthogonal_distance() -> void:
	var g := _grid(8, 8)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	# 3 straight steps = 3 * COST_NORMAL
	assert_eq(f.integration[g.idx(3, 0)], 30)


func test_diagonal_cheaper_than_l_shape() -> void:
	var g := _grid(8, 8)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	# (3,3) diagonal = 3 * 14 = 42 < L-shape 60
	assert_eq(f.integration[g.idx(3, 3)], 42)


func test_blocked_cell_unreachable_and_detour() -> void:
	var g := _grid(5, 1)  # corridor
	g.set_terrain(2, 0, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	assert_false(f.reachable(g.idx(2, 0)), "blocked cell itself unreachable")
	assert_false(f.reachable(g.idx(4, 0)), "wall fully cuts a 1-wide corridor")


func test_detour_around_wall() -> void:
	var g := _grid(5, 3)
	# vertical wall at x=2 with a hole at y=2
	g.set_terrain(2, 0, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	g.set_terrain(2, 1, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 1))
	assert_true(f.reachable(g.idx(4, 1)), "path exists through the hole")
	# Must be longer than the straight-line 4 steps
	assert_gt(f.integration[g.idx(4, 1)], 40)


func test_no_corner_cutting() -> void:
	var g := _grid(3, 3)
	# Block the two orthogonal cells around the diagonal from (1,1) to (0,0)
	g.set_terrain(0, 1, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	g.set_terrain(1, 0, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	assert_false(f.reachable(g.idx(1, 1)), "diagonal through a blocked corner pair is forbidden")


func test_directions_descend_cost() -> void:
	var g := _grid(16, 16)
	g.set_terrain(8, 8, SimGrid.Terrain.BLOCKED)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	# Every non-goal reachable cell's direction must point to a strictly cheaper cell.
	for cy in 16:
		for cx in 16:
			var i: int = g.idx(cx, cy)
			if not f.reachable(i) or f.integration[i] == 0:
				continue
			var d: Vector2 = f.direction_at(i)
			assert_true(d.length() > 0.0, "reachable cell %d has a direction" % i)
			var nx: int = cx + int(round(d.x))
			var ny: int = cy + int(round(d.y))
			var ni: int = g.idx(nx, ny)
			assert_lt(f.integration[ni], f.integration[i])


func test_rough_terrain_costlier() -> void:
	var g := _grid(5, 1)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	var normal_cost: int = f.integration[g.idx(4, 0)]
	g.set_terrain(2, 0, SimGrid.Terrain.ROUGH)
	f.compute(g, _goals(g, 0, 0))
	assert_gt(f.integration[g.idx(4, 0)], normal_cost)


func test_multiple_goals() -> void:
	var g := _grid(9, 1)
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(0, 0))
	goals.append(g.idx(8, 0))
	var f := FlowField.new()
	f.compute(g, goals)
	# middle cell flows to the nearer goal: cost = 4 steps
	assert_eq(f.integration[g.idx(4, 0)], 40)

```

`tests/unit/test_impact_vfx.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## ImpactVfx: per-tower style resolution (owner: 타워별 타격이펙트) + pooled
## lifecycle. Headless-safe — meshes/materials are plain resources.


func test_m1_towers_get_distinct_kinds() -> void:
	var kinds: Dictionary = {}
	for def in BastionLeague.towers():
		if def.damage <= 0.0:
			continue  # blockers never fire
		var st: Dictionary = ImpactVfx.style_for(def)
		kinds[def.id] = st["kind"]
		assert_gt(float(st["radius"]), 0.0, String(def.id))
		assert_gt(float(st["dur"]), 0.0, String(def.id))
	assert_eq(kinds[&"bastion_ballista"], &"spark")
	assert_eq(kinds[&"bastion_cannon"], &"blast")
	assert_eq(kinds[&"bastion_longbow"], &"spark")
	assert_eq(kinds[&"bastion_caltrops"], &"pulse")
	# ballista vs longbow share a kind but must differ in tracer look
	var b: Dictionary = ImpactVfx.style_for(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_ballista"))
	var l: Dictionary = ImpactVfx.style_for(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_longbow"))
	assert_ne(b["tracer"], l["tracer"])


func test_aoe_impact_radius_matches_def() -> void:
	var cannon: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_cannon")
	assert_eq(float(ImpactVfx.style_for(cannon)["radius"]), cannon.aoe_radius)
	var caltrops: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_caltrops")
	assert_eq(float(ImpactVfx.style_for(caltrops)["radius"]), caltrops.aoe_radius)


func test_unknown_future_tower_derives_style_from_stats() -> void:
	var frost := TowerDef.new()
	frost.id = &"verdant_frostspire"
	frost.damage = 3.0
	frost.slow_factor = 0.6
	frost.aoe_radius = 2.0
	frost.color = Color(0.3, 0.5, 0.9)
	assert_eq(ImpactVfx.style_for(frost)["kind"], &"pulse")
	var mortar := TowerDef.new()
	mortar.id = &"verdant_mortar"
	mortar.damage = 9.0
	mortar.aoe_radius = 1.5
	assert_eq(ImpactVfx.style_for(mortar)["kind"], &"blast")
	var sniper := TowerDef.new()
	sniper.id = &"verdant_sniper"
	sniper.damage = 20.0
	assert_eq(ImpactVfx.style_for(sniper)["kind"], &"spark")


func test_pool_lifecycle_and_overflow() -> void:
	var vfx: ImpactVfx = add_child_autofree(ImpactVfx.new())
	assert_eq(vfx.active_count(), 0)
	vfx.spawn(&"blast", Vector3.ZERO, Color.RED, 1.2, 0.3)  # blast chains a smoke puff
	vfx.spawn(&"pulse", Vector3.ONE, Color.BLUE, 1.6, 0.35)
	vfx.spawn(&"spark", Vector3.UP, Color.WHITE, 0.35, 0.16)
	assert_eq(vfx.active_count(), 4, "blast+chained smoke+pulse+spark")
	# Overflow far past the pool: round-robin must reuse slots, never crash/grow.
	for i in ImpactVfx.POOL_SIZE * 3:
		vfx.spawn(&"spark", Vector3.ZERO, Color.WHITE, 0.3, 0.2)
	assert_lte(vfx.active_count(), ImpactVfx.POOL_SIZE)
	# March time past every dur (longest = chained smoke 0.54s): all must expire.
	for i in 30:
		vfx._process(0.05)
	assert_eq(vfx.active_count(), 0, "all effects expired")


func test_cc0_billboard_textures_ship_with_repo() -> void:
	var vfx: ImpactVfx = add_child_autofree(ImpactVfx.new())
	assert_eq(vfx._tex.size(), 4, "flash/smoke/star/glow textures load from assets/vfx")
```

`tests/unit/test_path_validator.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## Anti-juggling / anti-softlock placement rules (R1/R2).


func _corridor() -> SimGrid:
	# 7x3 open field, core at (0,1), gate at (6,1)
	return SimGrid.new(7, 3)


func _cells(g: SimGrid, coords: Array) -> PackedInt32Array:
	var out := PackedInt32Array()
	for c in coords:
		out.append(g.idx(c.x, c.y))
	return out


func test_open_placement_ok() -> void:
	var g := _corridor()
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	var reason: String = v.validate_blocking_placement(
		g, _cells(g, [Vector2i(3, 0)]),
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 1)]), _cells(g, [Vector2i(6, 1)]))
	assert_eq(reason, PathValidator.OK)


func test_full_wall_rejected() -> void:
	var g := _corridor()
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	# Wall the entire column x=3 → gate cannot reach core → rejected
	var reason: String = v.validate_blocking_placement(
		g, _cells(g, [Vector2i(3, 0), Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(3, 2)]),
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 1)]), _cells(g, [Vector2i(6, 1)]))
	assert_eq(reason, PathValidator.REASON_BLOCKS_GATE)


func test_grid_untouched_after_rejection() -> void:
	var g := _corridor()
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	var cells := _cells(g, [Vector2i(3, 0), Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(3, 2)])
	v.validate_blocking_placement(g, cells,
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 1)]), _cells(g, [Vector2i(6, 1)]))
	for c in cells:
		assert_true(g.is_walkable(c), "hypothetical block restored")


func test_stranded_enemy_rejected() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(7, 1)  # 1-wide corridor
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	var enemies := EnemySim.new()
	enemies.spawn(5.5, 0.5, 10.0, 1.0, 0)  # enemy at x=5
	# Blocking x=3 cuts the enemy (x=5) off from the core (x=0)
	var reason: String = v.validate_blocking_placement(
		g, _cells(g, [Vector2i(3, 0)]),
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 0)]), PackedInt32Array(), enemies)
	assert_eq(reason, PathValidator.REASON_STRANDS_ENEMIES)


func test_enemy_between_block_and_core_ok() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(7, 1)
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	var enemies := EnemySim.new()
	enemies.spawn(1.5, 0.5, 10.0, 1.0, 0)  # enemy already past the block point
	var reason: String = v.validate_blocking_placement(
		g, _cells(g, [Vector2i(3, 0)]),
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 0)]), PackedInt32Array(), enemies)
	assert_eq(reason, PathValidator.OK)


func test_cannot_build_on_gate_or_core() -> void:
	var g := _corridor()
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	var reason: String = v.validate_blocking_placement(
		g, _cells(g, [Vector2i(6, 1)]),
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 1)]), _cells(g, [Vector2i(6, 1)]))
	assert_eq(reason, PathValidator.REASON_ON_GATE_OR_CORE)


func test_cannot_build_on_occupied() -> void:
	var g := _corridor()
	g.set_occupant(3, 1, 42)
	var v := PathValidator.new()
	var reason: String = v.validate_blocking_placement(
		g, _cells(g, [Vector2i(3, 1)]),
		_cells(g, [Vector2i(0, 1)]), _cells(g, [Vector2i(6, 1)]))
	assert_eq(reason, PathValidator.REASON_CELL_TAKEN)
```

`tests/unit/test_sim_core.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## SimClock fixed-tick semantics, RunRNG determinism, EnemySim movement/arrival.


func test_sim_clock_fixed_ticks() -> void:
	SimClock.reset()
	var ticks: Array = [0]
	var cb := func(_dt: float) -> void: ticks[0] += 1
	SimClock.sim_tick.connect(cb)
	SimClock.advance(0.1)  # 3 ticks at 30Hz
	assert_eq(ticks[0], 3)
	SimClock.advance(0.02)  # accumulates to 0.02+0.1-3/30 = below one tick? -> exact check below
	SimClock.sim_tick.disconnect(cb)
	SimClock.reset()


func test_sim_clock_determinism_across_framerates() -> void:
	# Same total time in different chunkings = same tick count.
	SimClock.reset()
	for _i in 100:
		SimClock.advance(1.0 / 144.0)
	var ticks_a: int = SimClock.tick_count
	SimClock.reset()
	for _i in 25:
		SimClock.advance((1.0 / 144.0) * 4.0)
	var ticks_b: int = SimClock.tick_count
	SimClock.reset()
	assert_eq(ticks_a, ticks_b)


func test_rng_deterministic_per_seed() -> void:
	RunRNG.seed_run(12345)
	var a: Array = [RunRNG.randi_range_sim(0, 1000), RunRNG.randi_range_sim(0, 1000), RunRNG.randf_sim()]
	RunRNG.seed_run(12345)
	var b: Array = [RunRNG.randi_range_sim(0, 1000), RunRNG.randi_range_sim(0, 1000), RunRNG.randf_sim()]
	assert_eq(a, b)


func test_rng_visual_stream_independent() -> void:
	RunRNG.seed_run(777)
	var sim_first: int = RunRNG.sim.randi()
	RunRNG.seed_run(777)
	RunRNG.visual.randi()  # consuming visual must not disturb sim
	var sim_second: int = RunRNG.sim.randi()
	assert_eq(sim_first, sim_second)


func test_enemy_moves_toward_goal_and_arrives() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(10, 1)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(0, 0))
	f.compute(g, goals)
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(8.5, 0.5, 10.0, 2.0, 0)  # 2 cells/sec, 8 cells to walk
	var arrived: int = 0
	for _t in 30 * 10:  # 10 sim-seconds, plenty
		e.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, g, f)
		arrived += e.arrived_last_step
		if arrived > 0:
			break
	assert_eq(arrived, 1, "enemy reached the core")
	assert_eq(e.count, 0, "arrived enemy removed")


func test_dead_enemy_removed_and_counted() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(4, 1)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(0, 0))
	f.compute(g, goals)
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	var i: int = e.spawn(3.5, 0.5, 5.0, 1.0, 0)
	e.damage(i, 99.0)
	e.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, g, f)
	assert_eq(e.killed_last_step, 1)
	assert_eq(e.count, 0)


func test_swap_remove_keeps_arrays_consistent() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(10, 1)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(0, 0))
	f.compute(g, goals)
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(9.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 100)
	var mid: int = e.spawn(8.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 200)
	e.spawn(7.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 300)
	e.damage(mid, 99.0)
	e.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, g, f)
	assert_eq(e.count, 2)
	var types := [e.type_id[0], e.type_id[1]]
	types.sort()
	assert_eq(types, [100, 300])


func test_query_radius_finds_neighbors() -> void:
	var g := SimGrid.new(16, 16)
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(4.5, 4.5, 10.0, 1.0, 0)
	e.spawn(5.5, 4.5, 10.0, 1.0, 1)
	e.spawn(12.5, 12.5, 10.0, 1.0, 2)
	var hits: PackedInt32Array = e.query_radius(g, 4.5, 4.5, 2.0)
	assert_eq(hits.size(), 2)
```

`tests/unit/test_tower_sim.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## TowerSim: firing, cooldown, AoE, slow, closest-to-core targeting.


func _arena() -> Dictionary:
	var g := SimGrid.new(12, 3)
	var f := FlowField.new()
	var goals := PackedInt32Array()
	goals.append(g.idx(0, 1))
	f.compute(g, goals)
	return {"g": g, "f": f}


func _ballista() -> TowerDef:
	return BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_ballista")


func test_tower_damages_enemy_in_range() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 20.0, 0.0, 0)  # stationary target
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_lt(e.hp[0], 20.0, "enemy took damage")
	assert_eq(t.shots_last_step.size(), 3, "one shot recorded")


func test_cooldown_prevents_machinegun() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 1000.0, 0.0, 0)
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	var hp0: float = e.hp[0]
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	var after_first: float = e.hp[0]
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])  # still cooling (0.7s interval vs 1/30s tick)
	assert_eq(e.hp[0], after_first, "no second shot inside cooldown")
	assert_lt(after_first, hp0)


func test_out_of_range_not_fired_at() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(11.5, 1.5, 20.0, 0.0, 0)  # far away
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(2, 1), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_eq(e.hp[0], 20.0)


func test_targets_closest_to_core() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(7.5, 1.5, 20.0, 0.0, 0)  # farther from core
	e.spawn(5.5, 1.5, 20.0, 0.0, 1)  # CLOSER to core (x=0)
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_lt(e.hp[1], 20.0, "closest-to-core enemy was hit")
	assert_eq(e.hp[0], 20.0, "farther enemy untouched")


func test_aoe_hits_cluster() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 30.0, 0.0, 0)
	e.spawn(7.0, 1.5, 30.0, 0.0, 1)
	e.spawn(10.5, 1.5, 30.0, 0.0, 2)  # outside splash
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_cannon"), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_lt(e.hp[0], 30.0)
	assert_lt(e.hp[1], 30.0)
	assert_eq(e.hp[2], 30.0)


func test_slow_applies_and_expires() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 500.0, 2.0, 0)
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_caltrops"), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_lt(e.slow_factor[0], 1.0, "slow applied")
	assert_gt(e.slow_timer[0], 0.0)
	# March time forward past the slow duration
	for _i in 60:
		e.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_lte(e.slow_timer[0], 0.0, "slow expired")


func test_upgrade_scales_damage_and_range() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	var i: int = t.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	var d0: float = t.damage_of(i)
	var r0: float = t.range_of(i)
	assert_true(t.can_upgrade(i))
	t.upgrade(i)
	assert_almost_eq(t.damage_of(i), d0 * 1.35, 0.001)
	assert_almost_eq(t.range_of(i), r0 * 1.10, 0.001)
	t.upgrade(i)
	assert_false(t.can_upgrade(i), "level 3 is max")
	var rampart := BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_rampart")
	var w: int = t.add_tower(rampart, Vector2i(7, 0), a["g"])
	assert_false(t.can_upgrade(w), "blockers can't upgrade")


func test_run_upgrade_costs_gold() -> void:
	RunRNG.seed_run(1)
	var run := RunSim.new()
	run.setup(BastionLeague.m1_scenario(), BastionLeague.enemies())
	run.place_gate(run.scenario.gate_slots[0])
	run.confirm_gates()
	run.place_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 12))
	var g0: int = run.gold
	var cost: int = run.towers.upgrade_cost(0)
	assert_eq(run.upgrade_tower(0), "")
	assert_eq(run.gold, g0 - cost)
	assert_eq(run.towers.level[0], 2)
	run.gold = 0
	assert_eq(run.upgrade_tower(0), RunSim.REASON_NO_GOLD)
	assert_eq(run.towers.level[0], 2, "rejected upgrade changed nothing")


func test_blocker_never_fires() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var e := EnemySim.new()
	e.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 20.0, 0.0, 0)
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	t.add_tower(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_rampart"), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, e, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_eq(e.hp[0], 20.0)
	assert_eq(t.shots_last_step.size(), 0)


func test_slowed_enemy_takes_bonus_physical_damage() -> void:
	var a := _arena()
	var plain := EnemySim.new()
	plain.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 100.0, 0.0, 0)
	var t1 := TowerSim.new()
	t1.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t1.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, plain, a["g"], a["f"])
	var plain_dmg: float = 100.0 - plain.hp[0]
	assert_gt(plain_dmg, 0.0)

	var slowed := EnemySim.new()
	slowed.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 100.0, 0.0, 0)
	slowed.apply_slow(0, 0.55, 1.2)
	var t2 := TowerSim.new()
	t2.add_tower(_ballista(), Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t2.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, slowed, a["g"], a["f"])
	var slowed_dmg: float = 100.0 - slowed.hp[0]
	assert_almost_eq(slowed_dmg, plain_dmg * TowerSim.SLOW_VULN_MULT, 0.001,
		"physical shot gets the slow-vulnerability synergy bonus")


func test_non_physical_tower_gets_no_slow_bonus() -> void:
	# Caltrops are control/slow, not physical — their own damage must not scale.
	var a := _arena()
	var slowed := EnemySim.new()
	slowed.spawn(6.5, 1.5, 100.0, 0.0, 0)
	slowed.apply_slow(0, 0.55, 1.2)
	var t := TowerSim.new()
	var caltrops: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_caltrops")
	t.add_tower(caltrops, Vector2i(6, 0), a["g"])
	t.step(SimClock.SIM_DT, slowed, a["g"], a["f"])
	assert_almost_eq(100.0 - slowed.hp[0], caltrops.damage, 0.001,
		"non-physical damage unchanged on slowed target")
```

`tests/unit/test_tower_visuals.gd`:

```gd
extends GutTest
## TowerVisualFactory + TowerIconRenderer contracts. Palette icons must come from
## the SAME mesh construction the board uses (owner 2026-07-10: buy buttons show
## the real tower, text+image).


func test_damage_tower_builds_base_plus_cylinder_body() -> void:
	var def: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_ballista")
	var node := TowerVisualFactory.build(def)
	assert_eq(node.get_child_count(), 2)
	var body := node.get_child(1) as MeshInstance3D
	assert_not_null(body)
	assert_true(body.mesh is CylinderMesh, "attacking tower body is a cylinder")
	node.free()


func test_blocker_builds_box_body() -> void:
	var def: TowerDef = BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_rampart")
	var node := TowerVisualFactory.build(def)
	var body := node.get_child(1) as MeshInstance3D
	assert_true(body.mesh is BoxMesh, "blocker body is a box")
	node.free()


func test_every_m1_tower_builds_with_def_color_body() -> void:
	for def in BastionLeague.towers():
		var node := TowerVisualFactory.build(def)
		assert_eq(node.get_child_count(), 2, String(def.id))
		var body := node.get_child(1) as MeshInstance3D
		var mat := body.mesh.material as StandardMaterial3D
		assert_eq(mat.albedo_color, def.color, String(def.id))
		node.free()


func test_visual_top_tracks_height() -> void:
	var tall := TowerVisualFactory.visual_top(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_longbow"))
	var short := TowerVisualFactory.visual_top(BastionLeague.tower_by_id(&"bastion_caltrops"))
	assert_gt(tall, short)
	for def in BastionLeague.towers():
		assert_gt(TowerVisualFactory.visual_top(def), 0.0, String(def.id))


func test_wall_block_builds() -> void:
	var node := TowerVisualFactory.build_wall_block()
	assert_eq(node.get_child_count(), 1)
	var m := node.get_child(0) as MeshInstance3D
	assert_true(m.mesh is BoxMesh)
	node.free()


func test_blocked_tiles_rise_above_ground_matching_wall_icon() -> void:
	# The wall buy button photographs a block rising above ground; the board
	# must agree (walls/rocks were silently extending underground before).
	# Base tile mesh is 0.5 tall, origin-centered: top = origin.y + scale_y * 0.25.
	var wall_xf: Transform3D = BoardView.tile_transform(Vector2i(0, 0), BoardView.BLOCKED_TILE_H)
	var wall_visible_top: float = wall_xf.origin.y + wall_xf.basis.y.length() * 0.25
	assert_almost_eq(wall_visible_top, TowerVisualFactory.wall_top(), 0.01,
		"blocked tile top matches the wall icon subject height")
	var ground_xf: Transform3D = BoardView.tile_transform(Vector2i(3, 7), 0.5)
	assert_almost_eq(ground_xf.origin.y + ground_xf.basis.y.length() * 0.25, 0.0, 0.01,
		"ground tile tops stay at y=0")


func test_icon_renderer_headless_safe() -> void:
	# The suite runs headless; the renderer must bail with {} and never touch
	# the render server (icons are a rendered-build-only nicety).
	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		pass_test("only meaningful under --headless")
		return
	var host: Node = add_child_autofree(Node.new())
	var icons: Dictionary = await TowerIconRenderer.icons_for(host, BastionLeague.towers())
	assert_eq(icons.size(), 0)
	assert_eq(host.get_child_count(), 0, "no viewport left behind headless")
```
